answer: Suppose every agent must post a bond that is slashed if its signed work fails an independent audit, while rewards accrue only after a challenge window. A Sybil operator can create a thousand identities, but cannot multiply the value of each bond or evade the shared audit: spreading stake across aliases does not reduce the total capital at risk. In a grove of agents, juniper and marble could label test tasks; the attacker must fund and maintain many bonds, then risks losing them all when fabricated work is exposed.
